Name: T's Farmhouse Annex - Beam Color Pack
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[color=#ffffff][size=5]This is an expansion mod for "[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48943]T's Farmhouse Annex[/url]"[/b].
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48943]T's Farmhouse Annex[/url] is required[/b] and must be installed to use this mod.[/size][/color]


[size=4]This mod lets you customize the beam color of each room and the hallway in the custom map added by [b]T's Farmhouse Annex[/b]. Choose from [b]26 different colors[/b] and configure each area individually.[/size]
[size=3]The colors you can choose from are...
[/size]
[quote][size=3]Black, White, Grey, Red, Orange, Vanilla, StrawYellow, CoffeeBrown, DarkerBrown, Cream, Yellow, Gold, LimeGreen, Green, Spruce, BabyBlue, SkyBlue, JojaBlue, Cyan, Blue, Violet, RoyalPurple, Purple, NeonPink, SAKURA, BabyPink[/size][/quote]You can also reduce the saturation of the beam textures, helping them blend more naturally with interior recolor mods.

[size=3]The beam color settings and texture files included in this mod are based on [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24533]Beams Color Change[/url][/b], another mod I created.[/size]
[size=3]If you'd like even more customization, [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24533]Beams Color Change[/url][/b] lets you independently change the colors of beams and various decorative objects throughout the vanilla game.[/size]

Currently supports English (default) and Japanese.



[center][size=2]( If you like this mod or any of the mods I've created, please endorse it! It improves my willingness to make mods!)[/size][/center]
